exact_isomorph_check.caveat: The IEEE MultiCounter+ full method and TWCRAC full method were not retrievable. Their occupied boundaries were handled conservatively; the negative search cannot license a first claim.

obvious_combination_assessment.judgment: Yes. As currently specified, the method is a straightforward composition of learned gap repair, additive/density count conservation, intact-versus-augmentation self-consistency, mismatched-identity negatives, and selective abstention. The exact conjunction appears unreported in the checked set, but novelty is not established by checklist conjunction.
obvious_combination_assessment.what_would_change_the_judgment: A nontrivial conservation identity or identifiability result, and evidence that endpoint transport beats matched reconstruct-then-count, gap-length/cut-position, generic residual-MLP, and crop-consistency baselines on source-disjoint unseen cut families while improving hidden-label count error rather than merely reproducing the frozen model's bias.

precise_delta: The only defensible residual is a failure-aware diagnostic/correction for a frozen per-track RAC response: on the same supplied identity, learn from intact-versus-synthetically cut pose features an endpoint-conditioned response-space boundary term; reject mismatched identities and abstain when the residual is unidentifiable. It is not a new tracker, re-ID method, count-additivity principle, density law, temporal-consistency principle, or abstention method.
fatal_risks: Pseudo-target tautology: the operator can simply learn the frozen base model's intact-minus-fragments residual, preserving or amplifying a biased counter.
Shortcut leakage: gap length, cut position, padding, fragment length, or boundary preprocessing may predict the residual without learning motion transport.
Non-identifiability: endpoint pose and velocity do not determine how many cycles occurred in a long or phase-ambiguous missing interval.
Trivial identity gate: because supplied identity is already the routing key, wrong-ID negatives may only teach an explicit key mismatch rather than meaningful identity isolation.
Composition rejection: reviewers can reasonably characterize the method as Tekin/OC-SORT-style gap correction plus RepNet/density additivity plus PAMS-style consistency plus a generic reject option.
Synthetic-to-real gap: success on artificial feature cuts does not establish robustness to detector failures, ID switches, or predicted-track fragmentation.

Measure degeneracy: if the frozen response is already nearly additive, the learned term reduces to window-edge calibration; if it is not additive, conservation may force agreement with a defective measure.
Unresolved primary access: full MultiCounter+ and TWCRAC methods were not available, so even the narrow residual cannot receive novelty clearance.
allowed_claims: We study a label-restricted diagnostic for compositional failure of a frozen per-track repetition response under deterministic synthetic fragmentation of supplied identity tracks.
The learner uses no count, period, density, or boundary labels; this statement must not be shortened to annotation-free because pose/tracks and source datasets may carry supervision.
If a predeclared gate passes, an endpoint-conditioned response correction reduced intact-versus-fragment discrepancy beyond matched simple baselines on source-disjoint unseen cut families.
If separately demonstrated, residual-based rejection improved a predeclared risk-coverage metric under synthetic gap ambiguity.
The contribution, if any, is a bounded failure diagnostic/correction for supplied tracks, not a tracker or base counter.

hard_kill_rules: Kill if unseen-cut reconstruction error exceeds 5% of intact frozen-response mass.
Kill if wrong-ID endpoint pairs receive more than 10% transport weight.
Kill on effective-rank collapse or constant/gap-only solution.
Kill if cutting one person changes any byte-identical output for untouched people.
Kill unless the proposed operator beats the best matched simple comparator on every predeclared unseen-cut family, not just the mean.
Kill if evaluator-only hidden count labels show no improvement over raw fragments and interpolate-then-count, or if matching the intact frozen response worsens true count error.
Kill if abstention does not improve the predeclared risk-coverage curve over residual-threshold and confidence baselines at the same coverage.
minimum_next_gate.novelty_exit_rule: Even a pass only supports a diagnostic contribution. Reconsider method novelty only if the gain survives all shortcut controls and the learned correction cannot be reduced empirically or mathematically to tracking reconstruction, scalar residual calibration, or ordinary crop consistency.

verdict.rationale: No exact five-part isomorph was found, but each substantive ingredient and the two central bridges—fragment endpoint repair and count/density conservation—already have strong primary priors. Their combination is an evident task transfer, full access to two 2026 near neighbors is incomplete, and the frozen-response target is scientifically vulnerable to tautology. This is not sufficient ICASSP method novelty.

limitations: This continuation is not fresh independent review; same-family output is provisional.
The bounded search cannot prove universal absence.
